text:
Predicates:
Timeless(x) ::: x is timeless.
DesignStyle(x, y) ::: x is a design style of y.
MassProductDesign(x) ::: x is a mass product design.
DesignBy(x, y) ::: x is a design by y.
Evocative(x) ::: x is evocative.
Dreamy(x) ::: x is dreamy.
Design(x, y) ::: x is a design of y.
Max(x) ::: x is Max.
ZahaHadid(x) ::: x is Zaha Hadid.
KellyWearstler(x) ::: x is Kelly Wearstler.
Y ::: a placeholder for design styles.
Premises:
∀x (DesignStyle(zahaHadid, x) → Timeless(x)) ::: All of Zaha Hadid's design styles are timeless.
∀x (¬Timeless(x) → ¬MassProductDesign(x)) ::: No mass product design is timeless.
∀x (DesignStyle(zahaHadid, x) ∨ DesignStyle(kellyWearstler, x)) ::: Either Zaha Hadid's design style or Kelly Wearstler's design style.
∀x (DesignStyle(kellyWearstler, x) → Evocative(x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are evocative.
∀x (DesignStyle(kellyWearstler, x) → Dreamy(x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are dreamy.
∀x (TimelessByMax(x) → (DesignBy(max, x) → MassProductDesign(x) ∧ Evocative(x))) ::: If a design by Max is timeless, then the design by Max is a mass product design and evocative.
Conclusion:
DesignBy(max, designByMax) ∧ Evocative(designByMax) ∧ Dreamy(designByMax)
